request: Stapel unsere Einnahmen pro Monat 2025 nach Quelle.

plan.title: Einnahmen pro Monat nach Quelle
plan.question: Alle Eingaenge pro Monat und Quelle 2025, eine Zeile je Monat und Quelle, Spalten month als 'YYYY-MM', topic und total_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       CASE WHEN description LIKE '%GEHALT%' THEN 'Gehalt'
            WHEN description LIKE '%KINDERGELD%' THEN 'Kindergeld'
            ELSE 'Sonstiges' END AS topic,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount > 0
GROUP BY month, topic
ORDER BY month, topic
reasoning_plan:
die Anfrage ist deutsch, also ist die Sprache de
sie sagt stapeln, und dabei zaehlt die Monatssumme genauso wie ihre Teile
gestapelte Balken zeigen beides in einem Bild
die Gruppe ist die Quelle des Geldes, eine Zeile je Monat und Quelle
die Spalten sind month, topic und total_eur, die Euro-Spalte zuletzt
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar_stacked, so barY carries a series and no layout
the columns are month, topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
a stack is taller than any single row, so the euro axis names no domain

request: Zeig mir pro Monat 2025, was jeder Kunde ueberwiesen hat.

plan.question: Die bezahlten Rechnungen pro Monat und Kunde 2025, eine Zeile je Monat und Kunde, Spalten month als 'YYYY-MM', client und total_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS client,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount > 0
  AND (description LIKE '%RECHNUNG%' OR description LIKE '%WERFT%' OR description LIKE '%VERLAG%'
       OR description LIKE '%KREATIV%' OR description LIKE '%NORDLICHT%' OR description LIKE '%HONORAR%'

der Zeitraum ist das ganze Jahr 2025, Monate ohne Zahlung fehlen als Luecke

the shape is line and these rows carry a series, so one lineY over all of them
the columns are month, client and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
client names the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
months on x with monthShort, euros on y over every figure in the rows, zero included

request: Show me how my BAfoeG adds up over 2025.

plan.title: BAfoeG adding up
plan.question: The running total of the BAfoeG payments from the Studentenwerk over the months of 2025, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, SUM(amount) AS got
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount > 0 AND counterparty LIKE '%Studentenwek%'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(got) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month

months on x with monthShort, euros on y

request: Compare how our income and our spending added up over 2025.

plan.title: Income and spending adding up
plan.question: The running total of income and of spending over the months of 2025, one row per month and topic, the topic named 'Income' or 'Spending', the running total inside each topic, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', topic and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, 'Income' AS topic, SUM(amount) AS moved
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount > 0
  GROUP BY month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, 'Spending' AS topic, SUM(-amount) AS moved
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0

)
SELECT month, topic, ROUND(SUM(moved) OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM months
ORDER BY month, topic

the columns are month, topic and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
topic names the series, so it is the z and the color channel on both marks and the legend goes on
